result.summary: Round 9 (colony-life). Both sweep-8 blocker/major findings are fixed: the worker:lost homeward trap (LD1) and the inert colony with plug soil left in the throat (RO1). founding/reopen.test is green for the first time since round 1. Direction 20.1 is done: a new long test (startPose.long.test.ts) founds the game at the start pose the way the first-play script does, for seeds 1-5 of all five Tier-1 archetypes, through the hand-over to a first worker outside. On the final tree all 25 pass: Fair-or-better 10 of 10, Poor 15 of 15. Before the three seal fixes SG1, SG2 and SG3 it was 22 of 25. The seed-2 flood (21b) is cause (2): rain came into the open shaft during the dig and the seal kept it in. The read-out was right. FD2 makes the queen move drowning brood onto dry floor in her sealed cell. R32b and R33 are implemented and recorded as GDD deviations. Paired arms on all 15 sweep-8 hand-overs, base HEAD dd966f1 against the final tree: workers at winter 190 -> 239 (14 better, 1 equal, 0 worse), viable 9 -> 13, eclosions 57 -> 113, untended brood deaths 78 -> 13, worker:lost 11 -> 3. Five long runs of the final tree against R34: 2 of 5 reach >= 1.0 x winter 1 and 0 of 5 reach >= 1.5 x (sweep 8: 0 and 0). R34 is not met. Both colonies lost in year 2 went into winter 1 short of carbohydrate while holding a protein store. The "## Round 9" section of docs/design/tasks/colony-life-ledger.md holds progress, accounting, ranking, fixes, what was tried and reverted, deviations and next steps. Evidence is in test-output/colony-life/round-9/.
causesRanked: 1. Brood left untended: 78 of 174 brood deaths in the base arm (45 %). With R33: 13. On the six colonies run in all three arms, R33 alone (final vs r32b) adds +22 workers at winter (4 better, 2 equal).
2. The founding never hands over from the start pose: 3 of 25 start poses failed at the seal (sg #4, we #4, pp #1), and each is a lost game. With SG1-SG3: 25 of 25.
3. Inert colony after the hand-over reopen: sg #3 made 0 trips all year. With RO1: trips 2 -> 91, eclosions 0 -> 4, viable.

4. Not fixed. Colonies go into winter 1 short of carbohydrate while holding a protein store, and 2 of the 5 long runs lose the colony in year 2: pp #3 has C 2.6 / P 12.2 mg, sg #2 has C 0.6 mg and its queen starves. Arm sg #2 carbohydrate stores at winter: base 6.1, r32b 3.2, final 0.4 mg.
5. Not investigated. Brood drowned after the hand-over is the largest brood cause left in the final arm: 34 of 143 deaths.
6. Homeward traps: worker:lost 11 in the base arm. With LD1: 3 (pp #1 6 -> 1, we #1 3 -> 1).
7. Eggs drowned in the sealed founding cell (seed-2 first play, 21b cause 2). Fixed by FD2.
